backend/main.mo: Defines product, blog, user, and page data models with access control, session handling, and CRUD storage maps for the canister backend.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records mapping features to affected frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of various frontend and backend source files.
frontend/CLOUDFLARE_CDN_SETUP.md: Guide detailing Cloudflare configuration steps for caching, optimization, compression, and performance tuning.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Documents production deployment issues, root causes, fixes, and a detailed pre‑deployment checklist for verification.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file setting metadata and preloading critical assets before loading the main React app.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZATION.md: Describes rendering, image, code-splitting, caching, and monitoring techniques used to achieve high PageSpeed scores.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Allows all crawlers and points them to the sitemap URL.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: Defines the site’s root URL with metadata for crawlers including last modified date and priority.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing static/dynamic caching, cache cleanup, and fetch strategies for offline support.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app shell handling routing, service worker registration, lazy loading, and admin/login modals.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlogManage: Admin interface to list, create, edit, and delete blog posts with form handling and query hooks.
frontend/src/components/admin/Newsletter: Displays newsletter subscribers and supports exporting signup data to CSV.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductMan: Admin panel for managing products, including listing, adding, editing, validating, and deleting products.
frontend/src/components/admin/SitePagesM: Admin tool to edit and bulk-update static site pages like privacy, terms, and contact content.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login modal with credential form, validation, and success/error handling.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin dashboard with authentication check, logout, and tabbed management interfaces for site content.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Modal that loads and displays a blog post by ID with loading, error, and scrollable rich-content rendering.
frontend/src/components/BlogTeaser.tsx: Displays a grid of recent blog posts with loading state and modal view support. Uses BlogCard components and fetches posts via useGetBlogPosts.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with newsletter subscription, social links, quick links, and legal modals. Uses PageModal and OptimizedImage for content and branding.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Provides a responsive site header with navigation, admin login/logout, and mobile menu support. Uses auth state and admin checks to conditionally render controls.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Shows the homepage hero section with promotional text, call‑to‑action buttons, and a banner image. Uses OptimizedImage for the main visual asset.
frontend/src/components/OptimizedImage.t: A lazy‑loading responsive image component with AVIF/WebP fallbacks and intersection‑observer‑based preloading. Manages loading state, errors, and priority rendering.
frontend/src/components/PageModal.tsx: Displays modal pages such as privacy policy, terms, and contact information. Fetches dynamic content via useGetPage with fallback defaults.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Implements a product grid with filtering, loading, and empty states, using memoized cards to display product details and affiliate links.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/RobotsTxt.tsx: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/Sitemap.tsx: Empty file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/Spinner.tsx: Provides a reusable SVG-based spinning loader component.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Implements a Zustand-based auth store and a hook providing login, logout, and session validation via an actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and related status flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for admin checks, product fetching, filtering, and product mutations tied to the actor and auth state.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles, CSS variables for light/dark themes, and utility classes including gradient and hover effects.
frontend/src/lib/web-vitals.d.ts: Type definitions for web-vitals metrics and reporting functions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters via query strings, hashes, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, shadows, animations, and enabling plugins like typography and container queries.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite configuration with React plugin, path aliases, build optimizations, vendor chunking, and dev server setup.
project_state.json: Defines project state and goals for improving mobile performance, accessibility, and SEO, including required image formats and a list of optimization features. Highlights issues with PageSpeed metrics, robots.txt validity, and sitemap delivery.
